description.en: Sets an anti-aliasing mode: the first argument is 0 or 1 (probably the screen, 0 being the top one) and the mode 0 to 2. The camera animation scenes of the matches switch the top screen to mode 1 while they play and back to 0 afterwards.
Mode, 0 to 2 (0 is the normal mode).

true once set.
false if the screen is above 1 or the mode above 2 (nothing changes).
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Around a camera animation (real usage, from ev44010001.nut)
